author: Electricks94
body:
#### PR description:

This PR introduces `AoSWrapper` as a nested class of the SoA layout. It provides the same utilities as the SoA class, i.e., `View`, `ConstView`, and `Metadata`, making it a suitable template for `PortableCollections`. The `View` of the `AoSWrapper` class comes with a `transpose` function that copies an element at index i from an `SoA::ConstView` to the `AoSWrapper`.  This function is used to add a `transpose` function to the `PortableCollections` which copies all data from an SoA layout to an AoS layout. The functionality is also added to transpose from an AoS layout to an SoA layout. 

The idea of this PR was previously introduced by @leobeltra in [#49072](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/49072). This PR sharpens the implementation by closing misalignments between the SoA View and AoS View and strongly extending the test cases to ensure that both work in the same way. Furthermore, SoA element and View methods are now aligned between the SoA and AoS versions as well, and the AoS ConstView can be used together with the `SoAMultiView` introduced [here](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51458).

The data members of the `AoSWrapper` are also designed in a way that they can easily be serialized by ROOT. This means Eigen objects are not directly part of the `aos_` data member. Instead, Eigen objects are represented by `std::array<ScalarType, Row * Cols>` on the buffer, and `Eigen::Map` is used for the data access in the View. ROOT I/O and schema evolution are tested by a set of tests used for the SoA version as well


#### PR validation:

This PR is purly technical and a new feature. It is tested by the unit tests which have been extended for the functionality of the PR

@leobeltra @felicepantaleo FYI
title: Support for AoS datalayout for SoATemplate
